experiment: ten sequential WebView create/destroy cycles in one uninstrumented WPE Flutter Release probe process

probe.sequence: The probe ran one automatic create/destroy cycle, then xdotool F5 triggered nine more cycles in the same app process. Each destroy was followed by a 30-second wait before sampling.

environment.scope_limit: Single diagnostic probe process; software rendering with WebKit sandbox and GBM disabled; not product integration, hardware GBM, a leak proof, or docs/04 acceptance.

measurement.private_mib_definition: sum of Private_Clean and Private_Dirty across web_engine_probe and its direct WPE children

lifecycle.WPEWebProcess: present at each open sample; absent at each destroy+30s sample
lifecycle.WPENetworkProcess: remained through all samples; its PSS stayed about 30.1-30.3 MiB

interpretation: Destroy+30s private/PSS did not return to the initial baseline over ten cycles; cycle-to-cycle values fluctuated, while the final cycle remained 81.20/83.63 MiB above baseline.
The WebKit file mapping increased mainly after the first cycle and then remained stable; anonymous mappings and the process heap accounted for most later increases.

smaps identifies page residency and mapping categories, not whether allocations are live objects, allocator-retained pages, caches, or a specific library's resources; this does not prove a leak or identify its owner.

artifacts.raw_maps_and_smaps: compressed per-process snapshots; smaps_rollup remains uncompressed
